description: Defines classes and methods for decoding preloaded data entries, including bit and Huffman decoding, used in network data processing within Chromium project.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder
classes.description: Base class for decoding preloaded network data, including trie-based decoding and entry resolution.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Handles bit-by-bit reading from a byte stream, including decoding variable-length size values.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs Huffman decoding based on a simple two-byte tree structure.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a search key in the preloaded data trie, indicating if a relevant entry is found.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::ReadEntry
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for reading specific data entries from the trie.

methods.name: BitReader::Next
methods.description: Retrieves the next bit from the input stream.

methods.name: BitReader::Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits from the input stream.

methods.name: BitReader::DecodeSize
methods.description: Decodes a size_t value using a prefix code optimized for small values.

methods.name: HuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a character from the Huffman-encoded data using the Huffman tree.
